The Shell Trilogy - Japanese Language Restoration Patch
========================================================
by That-Ruben

Restores the Japanese text option in the western (Shiravune) releases of
the Kara no Shoujo remasters:

  The Shell Part I   - Inferno
  The Shell Part II  - Purgatorio
  The Shell Part III - Paradiso

The complete Japanese script is already inside the western releases;
only the option to display it was removed. This patch re-enables it.

Features
--------
- Japanese as a 4th language: Config > Language Select
- Instant JP/EN toggle in-game: press L (works mid-scene, also switches
  the backlog retroactively)
- A small "JP" toggle button in the in-game button row
- Menus stay in English. The releases contain no Japanese menu art,
  only the story text.

Install
-------
Copy each file into that game's folder, next to the game's .exe:

  TheShell.pfs.080   - The Shell Part I   - Inferno
  TheShell2.pfs.080  - The Shell Part II  - Purgatorio
  TheShell3.pfs.080  - The Shell Part III - Paradiso

You can install any or all of them; the games are independent.

Uninstall: delete the file(s) again. Saves are not affected either way.

Built from and tested with the GOG releases. Steam and Jast versions
should be compatible.
